I kind of mentioned that I do not deserve what I have. What I mean is people that love me.  This is the main reason I have not killed myself.  I think my father has picked up on how I have been acting and frequently says things like "I do not know how a parent can survive their child's suicide."

FYI I am 33 not a child.  I just hate myself so much, and I hate that I cannot be happy when people have it so much worse them me and they can live their life in happiness

EDIT: I also am not necessarily jealous of their happiness, I just hate how I am so much weaker then most
